test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

The streets are crowded with tribal urchins in tattered jackets, bowlegged donkeys hauling firewood, steep mountain trails, and occasional palanquins for arthritic bussinessman.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Bussinessman**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is Businessman.
 
• **Businessman** means **a person who conducts business, in the commerce sector**.
 
 
• Example, ***Travis is a proper businessman.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bowlegged** is correct. Bowlegged means **having outward curved legs**.

 
 
• Example, ***Peter runs weirdly as he is bowlegged***.
 
 
 
• **Palanquins** is correct. Palanquins is ***a covered litter used as a means of transport***.
 
 
• Example,*** the king entered the city in his palanquin***.
 
 
 
• **Urchins **is correct. Urchin means **a poor child in ragged clothes**.
 
 
• Example, ***big cities are filled with urchins.***
